# ONPOL-NUPLAN: rollout clips of the fixed and broken scenes (generated by scripts/on_clips.py index; do not edit)

Clips on the box under `/root/autodl-tmp/ujs/runs/onpol_nuplan/clips/`. One clip = one rollout (COL1's layout: bird's-eye view with the served plan, the two model frames of the newest slot, speed / gap / lead prob). Fixed = zero (collision, offroad or corridor) in both control seeds (s0, s1) and in neither seed of the arm; broken = the reverse. `no log` = the rollout passed and its rollout.asl was pruned (ot2_loop keeps failed rollouts; ON_KEEP_ASL=all keeps all). Map, actors and the logged path in the clips are privileged and drawn for the reader only.
